name: Ringspot the Rosette Cat
blurb: Ringspot, a stocky golden cat with bold black rosettes and a cream belly, stalks the tall garden grass and pounces on falling leaves.

name: Stubtail the Tufted Cat
blurb: Stubtail, a tawny-grey spotted cat with a short bobbed tail, tufted ear tips and a white chin, naps on the woodpile and swats at bees.

name: Ghostspot the Shadow Cat
blurb: Ghostspot, a stocky coal-black cat whose faint rosettes only show in bright sun, dozes on the warm garden wall with green-gold eyes.
